recommended_field_changes.coverage:
Referenced proposal V 4.0, May-2025 (13 pp), supplements signed contract 5196. Scope: technical audit/device inventory/data-flow and integration review; operational transition maintaining zero downtime/data integrity; retain existing hardware/network during transition; interim anomaly monitoring; on-site co-management and joint incident/escalation protocol (pp 6–7). Pilot GWL, DPP, RRM and IDS on isolated infrastructure, mirror selected ANPR streams, benchmark ingestion latency/validation/error/scalability, assess enhancement versus replacement, document committee decision/fallback and migration plan (pp 6–8). GWL handles ingestion; DPP validates/stores/integrates; RRM monitors/activates roadside units (pp 9–10). Design capacity up to 50,000 cameras is a design statement, not a purchased camera quantity (p 9).
Operations: 16/5 real-time monitoring, incident diagnosis, roadside health/remote activation/troubleshooting, predictive scaling, patches/updates, backup verification and storage management. Included customer-care package has 2 Operation/Dev Engineers; no promise of 2 concurrent/on-site engineers. Days, shift hours and time zone are not stated; no numeric SLA response/resolution/uptime target (pp 11–12). On-site and remote activities support Hybrid classification. All components on-premises; AES-256 at rest, TLS in transit, OAuth 2.0/RBAC (p 10). Signed contract dates/customer/price prevail over conflicting proposal text (signed p 2/cl 1 and proposal p 13).
